title: Phase 84 Food Systems, Local Provisioning And Community Resource Security Registry
scope: Inactive food-production, land, water, sovereignty, processing, storage, distribution, local procurement, workforce, access, affordability, nutrition, institutional meals, emergency reserve, contamination, circular-flow, and long-horizon resource-security controls assigned one-to-one to the eight Phase 83 collective-resilience chains.
interpretation_boundary: Food availability is not nutritional access; inventory is not usable reserve; local production is not resilient provisioning; procurement spend is not community benefit; waste diversion is not circular capacity; short-term distribution is not durable food security.
activation_rule: No Phase 84 record can open until its Phase 83 predecessor contains adopted institutions, civic capacity, public knowledge, tested preparedness, collective recovery, independent review, and dated receipts. None does.
